item.title: Will StubHub’s FanProtect promise protect me when I can’t see Jason Bonham?
item.description: Charlene Burgett faces every concertgoer's nightmare when she discovers her expensive StubHub tickets offer no view of Jason Bonham, the drummer she specifically came to see at the Celebrity Theatre in Phoenix. Can she get a refund?

item.title: Ski patrol won’t save you from a $30,000 rescue bill. But this might.
item.description: When it comes to skiing, it may be impossible to have too much travel insurance coverage.

item.title: Do airline passengers deserve to know the full fare?
item.description: The 5th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals vacated a Biden-era Department of Transportation (DOT) rule that would have forced airlines to show you a full fare up front. That included the cost of a checked bag, a carry-on, and changing your flight.

item.title: Are airlines about to get a free pass from the government?
item.description: Picture this: You're driving 85 in a 65-mph zone, and a state trooper pulls you over. But instead of a $200 ticket, he hands you a warning and a pamphlet on the importance of speed limits.

item.title: What you definitely need to know before you book a spring break trip
item.description: It may still be early February, but it's not too early to start thinking about spring break

item.title: Should I take an EV on my next road trip? Here’s the uncomfortable truth
item.description: Nathan Heinrich wanted an adventure when he rented a Ford Mustang Mach-E SUV for a Northern California road trip. Instead, he got a misadventure.

item.title: She paid $4,996 for a Broadway cruise — then she got this shocking phone call
item.description: Susan Kemen is a Broadway superfan, but the Broadway themed cruise she booked is apparently not a fan of hers. Just a day after she plunked down $4,996 to see her favorite performers on the Norwegian Gem, she received a disturbing phone call.

item.title: I heard noises under my rental car. Now I have a $2,000 bill from National!
item.description: Walter Gluzkin faces a months-long battle with National Car Rental over a damage claim on a Hyundai Sonata he returned just 30 minutes after picking it up. National's damage recovery unit is demanding his insurance information for repairs he says he never caused. Can National get away with that?

item.title: GE keeps fixing my fridge, but it won’t stay fixed – what now?
item.description: The freezer compartment on Paris Perlick's GE refrigerator keeps failing because of an elusive coolant leak. The manufacturer has tried to repair it five times over four years, but the problem persists. With a year left on her five-year warranty, Perlick fears the company is deliberately stalling until her coverage expires. Is it?

item.title: In Germany’s Eifel region, sustaining memories and nature (and a volcano or two)
item.description: The air grows heavy as you ascend the narrow, winding staircase of the Vogelsang-Turm, an observation tower with commanding views of Urftsee and Eifel National Park in western Germany.
